values.AssociatedLNGNotes: An August 2019 RBN Energy article says the Mountaineer Xpress and Gulf Xpress expansions were designed to serve Sempra's Cameron LNG. The article describes the two projects as linking Marcellus and Utica gas supply to LNG export markets on the Texas and Louisiana coasts.

verifications.note: RBN Energy article naming the Mountaineer Xpress and Gulf Xpress expansions, saying both are designed to serve Sempra's Cameron LNG and tagged LNG exports.

records.researcher_notes: Medium tier. The one trade press article ties the Mountaineer Xpress to Cameron LNG only as part of a pair with Gulf Xpress, so the tie is stated for both projects together. Gulf Xpress is a separate row that is not in this chunk, so it is not staged here. The article is from August 2019, so the current feed to Cameron may differ.

An August 2019 RBN Energy article says the Mountaineer Xpress and Gulf Xpress expansions were designed to serve Sempra's Cameron LNG. The article describes the two projects as linking Marcellus and Utica gas supply to LNG export markets on the Texas and Louisiana coasts. Staged as yes with the Cameron LNG Terminal name.
Searched for the Muskogee Pipeline and LNG. The line served a coal-to-gas conversion in Oklahoma. The LNG results belong to Enable's Gulf Run Pipeline, a different project. Left blank.
Searched for NEXUS and LNG. A court case over the FERC approval touched on gas exports, but no source ties this line to a named LNG terminal. Left blank.
Searched for NYMarc and LNG. The project was a proposed Iroquois line to New York that was never built. The LNG links found are about Broadwater, a different project. Left blank.

Searched for FM100 and LNG. The sources say FM100 carries Pennsylvania gas to Transco customers in the East. Any LNG link is indirect and runs through Transco's mainline, not this project. Left blank.
Searched for the National Fuel main line and LNG. No link to an LNG terminal was found. Left blank.
Searched for the Shippingport Lateral and LNG. The lateral feeds the Shippingport Power Station, and no LNG tie was found. Left blank.
Searched for the Natural Bridge Pipeline and LNG. It is a Black Hills utility line serving Casper, and no LNG tie was found. Left blank.
Searched for the NGPL East St. Louis lateral and LNG. A 2000 report describes it serving Illinois Power, with no LNG tie. Left blank.
Checked the NGPL system main line. The LNG ties found belong to NGPL's Texas-Louisiana Expansion and Gulf Coast projects, which are separate rows. The main line is not tagged. Left blank.
Searched for Nautilus and LNG. It is an offshore gas line feeding the Neptune processing plant in Louisiana. The Neptune LNG hits concern a Massachusetts facility, so no tie was found. Left blank.
